purpose: First-session public-data snapshot. Values are intentionally timestamped and must not be treated as live later.

pump.definition: Parent protocol metric; includes bonded-curve fees and linked Pump products under DefiLlama's stated methodology. Do not back out volume by dividing by one fee rate.

pumpswap.definition: DefiLlama's DEX-volume metric filters to pools with TVL >= $5,000 and at least 50 unique traders. It is not all Pump bonding-curve volume.

cross_chain_dex_volume.definition: DefiLlama total DEX volume, not a memecoin-only statistic.

pump.important_definition: Official Pump fee schedule updated 2026-05-20. This supersedes using a generic 0.3% PumpSwap adapter description for a small canonical pool.

meteora.important_definition: Meteora DBC fees are configuration-dependent; never apply a single fee to every pool.

jupiter.source: https://dev.jup.ag/docs/swap/add-fees-to-swap and live Jupiter Ultra order snapshot
jupiter.important_definition: Aggregator fee and routing differ by API/product, pair, and route. Quote immediately before an execution decision.

accessed_data_systems: DefiLlama public API (DEX volumes, fees and methodologies)
Jupiter public price / swap quote / Ultra order APIs
DexScreener public profiles, boosts and token-pair API
Solana / Pump / Raydium / Meteora / Jupiter official documentation
Zenodo, arXiv, SSRN and GitHub public research artifacts
known_collection_constraints: This environment could GET public APIs through the web fetch channel but could not POST direct Solana RPC JSON-RPC calls from the shell, so account-aware current priority-fee samples, direct transaction simulation, and raw holder transaction graphs were not collected.
No authenticated Birdeye, Helius, Dune, X, Telegram, GMGN or Bubblemaps API credential was available. Vendor labels and social counts were therefore not substituted with guesses.
Live prices, liquidity and fees can change materially after this window; every live candidate must be refreshed before any future recommendation.
